retrievals.assessment: Read the complete four-page Pfizer release. It retains the 3 February 2026 VESPER-3 results and states VESPER-4 was recently initiated while VESPER-5 and VESPER-6 were planned at that date. It does not establish UK authorisation, NHS access or retail supply.

Read the complete Pfizer release. It records Pfizer's 14 April 2025 decision to discontinue danuglipron after reviewing all data and regulatory input. It does not establish a treatment recommendation or availability.
